label: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology
blurb: A focused six-fact drill set for Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology.

topics.title: Aadhaar
topics.hook: Aadhaar is India's biometric-based unique identity system administered by UIDAI.
topics.explainer: Aadhaar is India's biometric-based unique identity system administered by UIDAI. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology

connections.fact: Aadhaar provides identity authentication used by services built on India Stack, alongside payments and consent-based data exchange layers.
DigiLocker can use Aadhaar-based authentication, but it stores and verifies documents rather than issuing the Aadhaar identity number.

topics.title: UPI
topics.hook: Unified Payments Interface is an instant payment system developed by the National Payments Corporation of India.
topics.explainer: Unified Payments Interface is an instant payment system developed by the National Payments Corporation of India. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology

connections.relationship: Instant-payment rail in digital public infrastructure
connections.fact: UPI is the interoperable payment layer commonly discussed as part of India Stack.
ONDC connects buyers and sellers across commerce applications, while UPI can settle payments made in that ecosystem.

topics.title: India Stack
topics.hook: India Stack is a set of interoperable Indian digital-public-infrastructure layers for identity, payments, and data exchange.
topics.explainer: India Stack is a set of interoperable Indian digital-public-infrastructure layers for identity, payments, and data exchange. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology

connections.fact: Aadhaar authentication forms an identity layer within the wider collection of India Stack digital public infrastructure.
UPI supplies instant bank-to-bank payments as a major transaction layer associated with India Stack.

topics.title: DigiLocker
topics.hook: DigiLocker is an Indian platform for issuing, storing, and verifying digital documents.
topics.explainer: DigiLocker is an Indian platform for issuing, storing, and verifying digital documents. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology

connections.fact: Aadhaar can authenticate a user; DigiLocker lets that user access authentic digital certificates and records.
DigiLocker complements India Stack by enabling digital issue, storage, and verification of official documents.

topics.title: ONDC
topics.hook: The Open Network for Digital Commerce is an Indian initiative for interoperable digital-commerce networks.
topics.explainer: The Open Network for Digital Commerce is an Indian initiative for interoperable digital-commerce networks. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology

connections.relationship: Open networks for commerce and payment
connections.fact: ONDC makes commerce participants interoperable, while UPI makes bank-account payments interoperable.
Both use open standards to reduce dependence on a single closed platform, but ONDC focuses on commerce discovery and transactions.

topics.title: ISRO
topics.hook: The Indian Space Research Organisation is India's national space agency.
topics.explainer: The Indian Space Research Organisation is India's national space agency. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Indian Digital Ecosystem and Indigenous Technology

connections.fact: ISRO’s Bhuvan geospatial platform has hosted an Aadhaar portal for locating enrolment and update centres administered by UIDAI.
ISRO supplies satellite connectivity and NavIC positioning capabilities, while India Stack supplies interoperable identity, payment, and consent layers used by digital services.

Nikola Tesla, Alexander Popov and others also appear in radio-history questions.

questions.q: Which authority administers India's Aadhaar identity system?
questions.explanation: The Unique Identification Authority of India issues and administers Aadhaar; NPCI operates UPI and ISRO leads space activity.

questions.q: Which organisation developed the Unified Payments Interface?
questions.explanation: The National Payments Corporation of India developed UPI as an interoperable instant bank-payment system.

questions.q: Which trio best represents India Stack capabilities?
options: Identity, payments, and consent-based data exchange
Search, social networking, and targeted advertising
Tax assessment, land surveying, and weather forecasting
Hardware manufacturing, chip fabrication, and cloud hosting
questions.explanation: India Stack describes interoperable digital public infrastructure spanning identity, paperless services, payments, and data empowerment.

questions.q: A university issues a verifiable digital degree to a student's online account. Which platform fits?
questions.explanation: DigiLocker supports digital issue, storage, retrieval, and verification of official documents such as certificates.

questions.q: What problem is ONDC designed to address?
options: Authentication against a biometric identity number
Issue and verification of government documents
questions.explanation: The Open Network for Digital Commerce uses common protocols so buyers, sellers, logistics providers, and applications can transact across platforms.

questions.q: Which institution is India's national space agency?
questions.explanation: The Indian Space Research Organisation develops launch vehicles, satellites, and exploration missions for India.

questions.q: Which statement corrects a common mix-up?
options: Aadhaar is identity; DigiLocker manages digital documents
Aadhaar is a payment rail; UPI assigns identity numbers
DigiLocker is a commerce network; ONDC stores certificates
ONDC authenticates biometrics; Aadhaar lists online sellers
questions.explanation: Aadhaar establishes a unique identity and authentication capability, while DigiLocker handles electronic records and certificates.

questions.q: An ONDC shopper authorises an instant bank payment with a virtual payment address. Which rail is being used?
questions.explanation: ONDC provides commerce interoperability, and UPI can provide the separate instant bank-to-bank payment step.

questions.q: How does Aadhaar relate to India Stack?
options: It supplies an identity layer within the broader infrastructure
It supplies the instant-payment messaging layer
It supplies the consent-based financial-data exchange layer
It supplies the open digital-commerce discovery layer
questions.explanation: Aadhaar authentication is a foundational identity capability associated with India Stack, not the whole stack by itself.

questions.q: Which comparison between ONDC and UPI is sound?
options: Both promote interoperability, for commerce and payments respectively
ONDC settles bank transfers while UPI lists sellers and catalogues
Both are closed marketplaces controlled by one retailer
UPI provides product discovery while ONDC authenticates payment PINs
questions.explanation: ONDC opens commerce-network participation, while UPI enables interoperable payments between bank accounts and applications.
